title: Understanding Your Rights After an Accident (General Education)
metaDescription: How insurance, medical bills, and attorney referrals typically work after a crash—general education, not legal advice.
excerpt: How insurance, medical bills, and attorney referrals typically work—without legal advice.

sections.heading: Medical care
paragraphs: After an accident, you generally have the right to seek medical treatment and keep records of your care.

sections.heading: Insurance communication
paragraphs: You may communicate with insurers, but you are not required to accept the first offer or give a recorded statement immediately.

sections.heading: Legal representation
paragraphs: You may consult a licensed attorney in your state. WreckMatch LLC can refer you to independent attorneys at no cost to you for the referral.

faq.question: Does AccidentSurvivalGuide.com provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. We provide general education only. WreckMatch LLC is a legal referral service, not a law firm.
